versions.changelog:
Initial release of AI Daily Brief (AI 每日简报) skill:

- Delivers concise daily summaries of major AI industry news, executive statements, product launches, and academic papers from authoritative sources worldwide.
- Focuses on structured, category-based output for quick browsing: big company news, industry leader comments, technology products, and selected papers.
- Gathers and summarizes only the most important developments from the past 24 hours, minimizing information overload.
- Supports fallback search strategies using Tavily, 博查, and SearXNG to ensure reliable news gathering.
- Outputs Chinese-language briefs with source links and key highlights.
